Privacy Policy

Smith Tax Services collects the personal information you give us so that we can prepare your tax returns and run payroll for your business.

We do not sell your information. We share it only with the IRS, state tax agencies, and others you authorize in writing, or as required by law.

You may ask us for a copy of the information we hold about you at any time. Questions about this policy can be sent to office@smithtax.example.
